# Mirror Maiden
Mirror Maidens spring forth from reflections and the minds of those who look too deeply. They move through angles unseen to most and despise being seen. They have one clear motivation: end those who can see them.
## So I'm a mansus ghost?
[tex path="/Textures/_Omu/Interface/Heretic/faction_bigIcons.rsi" state="madness"/]
Enjoy being a spooky ghost! Anyone with the appropriate faction icon is mad and can see you. Go beat 'em up. It's poor form to camp medical and prevent their revival. Your motivation is to end those who can see you. Dead people cannot see you. You are fine to mess around and haunt the crew as a wider whole. They messed up by shaping you into existence! This could include breaking lights, jaunting around them, opening doors or even moving things around. You should not directly harm them.
## So I'm seeing things?
So you delved too deep and got haunted. Well done. The best way of curing madness is mannitol and psychiatric meds from medbay. The chaplain can also bless you with his bible!
